# ADR 0005: Cache results keyed by normalised input and list version

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Sanctions screening service

## Context

Repeated screenings of the same names are common.

## Decision

Cache in Redis with the list version in the key so a new version naturally invalidates entries.

## Consequences

Fast repeats, no stale decisions across list updates.

## Alternatives considered

Time-based expiry only (stale after updates).
